verdict.rationale: A recorded hands-on install used `npx skills add obra/superpowers --skill test-driven-development`. It copied only that one skill into ./.claude/skills/ and read it back cleanly, because Superpowers ships each skill as a separate markdown folder. The product's own documented install path is the whole plugin (`/plugin install superpowers@superpowers-marketplace`, `devin plugins install obra/superpowers`), and selective install relies on a general-purpose `skills` installer that may not be Superpowers' own tooling. missing for 10: first-party documentation of per-skill selective install, a native per-skill option in the plugin/marketplace install, guidance on skill inter-dependencies when installing a subset.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install only the specific skills I want from a collection instead of taking the whole bundle

citations.quote: `npx -y skills add obra/superpowers --skill test-driven-development -a claude-code -y --copy` fetched the repo, copied the skill to ./.claude/skills/test-driven-development/
Skills are plain, selectively-installable markdown folders.
